  • Maps of Content or MOCs (Storage Index): A single Markdown file that acts as a dashboard for a specific project or topic. It contains very little text of its own—it is simply a structured list of links to your atomic notes and relevant daily logs.

2. Setting Up the Daily State Template

To make "state dumps" completely frictionless, automate your Daily Note layout. When you open Obsidian or hit your daily note shortcut, it should instantly spin up a clean file pre-configured to capture your active working memory.
